judge_notes: Consolidated 9 distinct assays: HTR, OFT, EPM, NOE, 3-chamber SIT, TST (naive + repeated combined as one assay per rubric), FST, cued fear conditioning + extinction (before- and after-retrieval injection combined as one assay per rubric), and social CPP.
B5 for 3-chamber SIT scored 2 (Restricted social interaction) per rubric — stimulus mouse in wire cup.
B4 for 3-chamber SIT scored 1 (ethological) because investigation/sniffing scored via nose-in-zone constitutes social investigation; this matches qwen's interpretation.
B5 for social CPP scored 1 (Social construct, individual testing) — social conditioning with cagemates but test done alone.
OFT B1 scored 2 (2-3 measures): velocity and center time both reported; B2 scored 1 because 5-min time bins of velocity reported in Ext Data Fig 2.
HTR B2 scored 1 due to explicit time-course analysis showing first 10 min effect.
D2 for OFT scored 1 (15-60 min) based on 30-min duration explicitly shown in Ext Data Fig 2.
D2 for fear conditioning scored 1: extinction sessions of 180s hab + 10 tones at 55-65s ITI ≈ 15-20 min.
FST setup_restrain scored yes per rubric (FST cylinder is listed as restraint).
day_night_flipped scored not_reported with low confidence: light cycles given but no explicit statement of reversal relative to testing phase across all labs.
Sample sizes per assay not broken out in main text; left null with low confidence.

Dropped duplicate candidate entries: glm split TST (naive) and repeated TST — merged into single TST assay; gptoss split FC by injection timing — merged into single fear conditioning assay (consistent with rubric: same paradigm under different timing of drug administration is one assay).
